2609.17274.title: After the Party: Governing What a Viral Agent-Skill Ecosystem Left Behind
2609.17274.paper_summary: AI agents increasingly act through agent skills, i.e., natural-language instructions, that direct a host agent toward shell, network, credential, file, and process actions, and public registries distribute them at scale. In the first half of 2026, the OpenClaw AI agent went viral, and its public skill registry boomed: the observable stock nearly doubled in 91 days, and a majority of the listings visible in June were created in just two months. By the end of our study window, the wave had crested, and monthly listing creation and core-repository activity were falling from their spring peaks. This paper measures what the boom left behind, drawing on the OpenClaw Git history, its GitHub issues and pull requests, and three ClawHub registry snapshots. Attention is concentrated: the top 10% of skills received 46.93% of all downloads. No simple skill features (like size or download counts) remained a stable predictor of continued listing once creation cohort and skill age were controlled. Human scrutiny did not stay: 77.86% have zero stars and zero comments, while 85.06% of the readable skills carry privilege evidence. And automated cleanup is not ready: the three security scanners disagreed on 23,702 of the 61,990 skills they all cover. After human adjudication, weighted scanner sensitivity against the reference standard ranged from 21.67% to 61.06%. Governing fast-growing agent-skill registries cannot rely on simple metadata or single scanner scores; it requires robust, transparent measurement and independent validation.
2609.17274.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理越來越多地通過代理技能行動，即自然語言指令，這些指令引導主代理進行外殼、網絡、憑證、文件和過程操作，而公共登記處則大規模地分發這些技能。2026 年上半年，OpenClaw AI 代理迅速走紅，其公共技能登記處蓬勃發展：可觀察的庫存在 91 天內幾乎翻了一番，而在 6 月可見的大多數列表僅在兩個月內創建。到我們研究的結束時，這股浪潮已經達到頂峰，月度列表創建和核心庫活動從春季高峰回落。本文測量了這次繁榮留下的痕跡，參考了 OpenClaw 的 Git 歷史、其 GitHub 問題和拉取請求，以及三個 ClawHub 登記快照。注意力集中：前 10% 的技能獲得了 46.93% 的所有下載。沒有簡單的技能特徵（如大小或下載次數）在控制創建群體和技能年齡後仍然是持續列表的穩定預測因子。人類審查並未持續：77.86% 的技能沒有星級和評論，而 85.06% 的可讀技能帶有特權證據。而自動清理尚未準備好：三個安全掃描器在它們所涵蓋的 61,990 個技能中對 23,702 個技能存在分歧。經過人類裁定後，加權掃描器的靈敏度與參考標準相比範圍從 21.67% 到 61.06%。管理快速增長的代理技能登記處不能依賴簡單的元數據或單一掃描器分數；這需要穩健、透明的測量和獨立的驗證。
2609.17274.author: Yunpeng Xiong et.al.
